daily.title: Serbia's Vucic calls snap elections after nearly two years of protests
daily.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic on Wednesday called snap parliamentary elections for October 25. They are expected to be a key test of his right-wing populist Serbian Progressive Party after nearly two years of student-led anti-corruption protests.

daily.title: Logement abordable : les propositions controversées du commissaire européen Jorgensen
daily.summary: Dan Jorgensen propose notamment un critère de définition des zones en tension, et s’intéresse aux manières de diminuer la pression sur le prix des logements ou aux leviers à la disposition des élus pour réguler l’acquisition de résidences secondaires. Mais son texte suscite inquiétudes et méfiance.

daily.title: Iran attacks US base after American strikes on tankers
daily.summary: Iran said it fired ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan early Wednesday, in retaliation for US strikes on Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman and near Kharg Island, off Iran’s coast. The US said five Iranian tankers were destroyed.

daily.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu lance une « opération déminage » auprès des chefs d’entreprise en promettant une baisse de la contribution exceptionnelle
daily.summary: A trois semaines de la présentation du projet de loi de finances 2027, le premier ministre confirme que la surtaxe « exceptionnelle » sur les grandes entreprises ne va pas disparaître. Mais elle devrait baisser, et un nouveau dispositif être créé pour favoriser la reprise d’entreprises par les salariés.

daily.summary: Lors d’un débat au Bundestag, le chancelier conservateur a dénoncé les projets migratoires du parti prorusse et anti-immigration. Dimanche, celui-ci a recueilli près de 44 % des voix lors d’une élection régionale.

daily.title: Travellers in UK face ongoing disruption after air traffic control glitch
daily.summary: Flights from British airports began to resume Wednesday after a glitch in the country's air traffic control service left hundreds of thousands of passengers stranded. Authorities warned that travellers would continue to experience delays as airlines scrambled to recover from the outage.

daily.title: US bans Canadian alcohol, motorcycles and dairy products as trade spat escalates
daily.summary: The US and Canada escalated a bitter trade dispute on Tuesday, with Washington imposing new import bans on Canadian alcohol, motorcycles and dairy products as Ottawa's retaliatory tariffs on US goods took effect.

daily.title: New York City releases post-9/11 air toxicity information kept secret for 25 years
daily.summary: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Tuesday announced the release of tens of thousands of documents detailing what city officials knew about toxic air after the September 11 attacks as the 25th anniversary approaches and thousands still suffer from related illnesses.

daily.title: Smithsonian chief steps down amid Trump pressure over how US history is presented
